texts: LEVEL SHIFTERS  LM339 (+5 V / VL), open collector, pulled up to 0 V = logic 1 of the channel
U44 B-D unused: inputs tied, outputs open
THRESHOLDS  (VTH = 1.65 V,  VTHN = -7.5 V)  and boot defaults
L_SEL idles high (deselected), L_OE idles low (registers off)
100 nF per LM339 on +5 V and VL;  C bulk on VL, +5 V, +3V3
CHANNEL SUPPLY SWITCH  K23/K24 G2RL-2 24 V (8 A), coils from U3 ch.6 (DRV_PWR)
NC contacts unused: channel supplies are off until the firmware sets CTL_PWR.
K24 second pole switches VECAM (+12 V via JP3).
PTC FUSES (0.75 A hold) AND 0.1 R SHUNTS  ->  CH_P16 / CH_N16 / CH_VL to J2
CURRENT SENSE  (I = V(Rout) x Rg / (Rs x Rout): +16 V 1 A = 3.0 V;  -16 V 1 A = 3.0 V down from 3.0 V;  VL 0.5 A = 2.55 V down)
24 V DC INPUT - fuse, TVS, reverse-polarity P-FET
Q1 conducts only with correct polarity; D2 clamps Vgs to 15 V.
U21  LM2576HV  INVERTING  24 V -> N17A (-19.7 V)
U22  LM2576HV  INVERTING  24 V -> N17L (-19.7 V)
U30  LM2577  BOOST  24 V -> HV50 (+50 V)
PH48 is switched to the mic pins by K12 (sheet P4).
U27  LM337  N17L -> VL (-15 V logic)   (heatsink HS6)
U28  LM337  N17L -> VR (-15 V recall)   (heatsink HS7)
U29  78L12  P17 -> P12 (+12 V relay / VECAM)
HS1-HS3 on U20-U22 (LM2576).  LM337 tab = input: heatsinks must not touch.
TO CHANNEL:  J1 = back connector 1 (DIN 41612 C, 96),  J2 = back connector 2 (DIN 41612, 64)
J1, J2 sit on the underside of the Main board, front edge; the Bus board (J3, J4) is stacked above.
J12  TO BUS BOARD  (2x20, 2.54 mm socket)
Mates with J13 (pins) on the Bus board, 11 mm stack.
OUTPUT RELAYS  TQ2-24V  (A side: K13-K16, K21;  B side: K17-K20, K22)
AUDIO INTERFACE  (XLR, pin 1 = GNDA, shell = GNDA)
J5 OUT1 -> generator   J6 OUT2   J7 <- A (meas.)   J8 <- B (meas.)
LOGIC OUTPUTS  CD4094 x5  (serial in, VDD = 0 V, VSS = VL -15 V, levels as in the channel)
DECOUPLING  (one 100 nF per package, at the supply pins)
Chain: SDI4 -> U31 DATA, QS -> next DATA.  CLK4 / STB4 / OE4 from the level shifters (P11).  Outputs LDRV_n -> P9.
